lines.say: This commit adds a switch that picks the narrator of a video.
The new choice is the say command in macOS, free and offline.
lines.tts: The new choice is the say command in mac O S, free and offline.

lines.say: Before, tts.dart sends every line to ElevenLabs.
lines.tts: Before, T T S dot dart sends every line to Eleven Labs.

lines.say: That needs an API key, and every video costs credits.
lines.tts: That needs an A P I key, and every video costs credits.

lines.say: Now tts.dart reads tts.provider from the config, and elevenlabs is the default.
lines.tts: Now T T S dot dart reads T T S dot provider from the config, and Eleven Labs is the default.

lines.say: Set it to say, and this Mac reads the lines for free.
Take 1 line from the rebase video: Main has commits A and B.
lines.tts: Take one line from the rebase video: Main has commits A and B.

lines.say: The say command speaks that line alone, into a WAV file.
lines.tts: The say command speaks that line alone, into a wave file.

lines.say: ffmpeg trims the silence at each end, and 1.39 seconds are left.
lines.tts: F F M peg trims the silence at each end, and one point three nine seconds are left.

lines.say: tts.dart joins the clips and writes each line's start and end.
lines.tts: T T S dot dart joins the clips and writes each line's start and end.

lines.say: ElevenLabs makes the same files, so pad.dart and layout.dart do not change.
lines.tts: Eleven Labs makes the same files, so pad dot dart and layout dot dart do not change.

lines.say: In main, a missing provider means elevenlabs, and that path returns early.
lines.tts: In main, a missing provider means Eleven Labs, and that path returns early.

lines.say: Any other name goes to localVoice, and an unknown name stops the run.
lines.tts: Any other name goes to local voice, and an unknown name stops the run.

lines.say: localVoice maps say to a voice, Aman by default.
lines.tts: Local voice maps say to a voice, Aman by default.

lines.say: A new local model, such as Kokoro, is 1 more case here.
lines.tts: A new local model, such as Kokoro, is one more case here.

lines.say: Check that a config with no tts block still voices with ElevenLabs.
lines.tts: Check that a config with no T T S block still voices with Eleven Labs.

lines.say: Check that a wrong voice name stops tts.dart, because say falls back in silence.
lines.tts: Check that a wrong voice name stops T T S dot dart, because say falls back in silence.

lines.say: Check that check.dart still runs the accent and likeness gates for a clone.
lines.tts: Check that check dot dart still runs the accent and likeness gates for a clone.
